macro.title: In the Aftermath of Last Week’s Rate Hike, Fed Officials Will Speak This Week
macro.what: In A Nutshell: A light economic calendar this week means the focus will be on digesting last week’s Fed meeting, and on any geopolitical developments
macro.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
macro.market: Lower rates support demand/valuations; higher rates pressure builders/REITs and slow transactions.

macro.title: Mortgage Rates Are Likely to Stay High as Fed Hikes Rates and Signals More to Come

macro.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
